items.title: Show HN: Halal Crypto Index – AAOIFI Shariah compliance screener for 800 coins
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN,
We built Halal Crypto Index (https://halalcryptoindex.com) to provide transparent, open-methodology Shariah screening for 820+ crypto assets based on AAOIFI financial ratios (debt/market cap, interest revenue, utility vs speculation).
Ecosystem:
• Live Web App: https://halalcryptoindex.com
• Telegram Mini App: https://t.me/Halal_Crypto_App_Bot/app
• MCP AI Server: https://smithery.ai/servers/tffsgsff/halal-crypto
• CERN Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23021995

items.title: Show HN: ThemesFor.app – a static website builder that doesn't hide the HTML
items.contentSnippet:
I originally built ThemesFor.app in 2018 while running a small web development agency.
One thing that kept bothering me with website builders was that they increasingly tried to hide the technical parts of building a website. That's useful for many people, but I wanted almost the opposite — a visual tool for people who are already comfortable with HTML and CSS.
ThemesFor.app is my attempt at that.

items.title: Show HN: GitGud – a free, open-source Git GUI with undo for any action
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I built GitGud out of frustration: no open-source Git GUI felt as nice as GitKraken. Bonus points if you get where the name comes from.
Highlights: undo for any git action (even rebases), drag a branch onto another to merge or rebase, interactive rebase and line-level staging.
It's open source, and feedback is really welcome!
Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50132140
Points: 2
